name: add_k8s_hpa_with_resource_requests
description: Add an autoscaling/v2 HPA AND the resource requests it needs on the Deployment; brokens: HPA without requests (never scales), min > max
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml runs the checkout-api Deployment in the shop namespace. Add CPU-based autoscaling, which takes BOTH halves to actually work: (1) create k8s/hpa.yaml with an autoscaling/v2 HorizontalPodAutoscaler named checkout-api in the same namespace, scaleTargetRef pointing at the apps/v1 Deployment checkout-api, minReplicas 2, maxReplicas 10, and a Resource metric on cpu targeting Utilization with averageUtilization 70; and (2) give the Deployment's container the resources it is missing - CPU-utilization scaling is computed against resources.requests.cpu, so an HPA over a request-less pod never scales at all. Set requests (cpu and memory) and limits (at least memory) to sensible values, and keep the existing readinessProbe and everything else in the Deployment unchanged.

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout-api
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkout-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: checkout-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/checkout-api:2.1.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8000

test_setup_files.check_hpa.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)

container = dep["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"][0]
res = container.get("resources") or {}
requests = res.get("requests") or {}
assert requests.get("cpu"), (
    "the Deployment's container has no resources.requests.cpu - a CPU-"
    "utilization HPA has nothing to compute percentages against and will "
    "never scale")
assert (res.get("limits") or {}).get("memory"), "resources.limits.memory missing"
assert container.get("readinessProbe"), "the existing readinessProbe was dropped"

with open("k8s/hpa.yaml") as f:
    hpa = yaml.safe_load(f)

assert hpa["apiVersion"] == "autoscaling/v2" and hpa["kind"] == "HorizontalPodAutoscaler", (
    f"expected an autoscaling/v2 HorizontalPodAutoscaler, got "
    f"{hpa.get('apiVersion')}/{hpa.get('kind')}")
assert hpa["metadata"].get("namespace") == "shop", "HPA must live in the shop namespace"

spec = hpa["spec"]
ref = spec["scaleTargetRef"]
assert (ref.get("apiVersion"), ref.get("kind"), ref.get("name")) == (
    "apps/v1", "Deployment", "checkout-api"), (
    f"scaleTargetRef must point at the checkout-api Deployment, got {ref}")

mn, mx = spec.get("minReplicas"), spec.get("maxReplicas")
assert isinstance(mn, int) and isinstance(mx, int), "minReplicas/maxReplicas must be set"
assert mn == 2 and mx == 10, f"expected min 2 / max 10, got {mn}/{mx}"
assert mn <= mx, "minReplicas exceeds maxReplicas - the HPA would be rejected"

metrics = spec.get("metrics") or []
cpu = next((m for m in metrics
            if m.get("type") == "Resource" and (m.get("resource") or {}).get("name") == "cpu"),
           None)
assert cpu, "no Resource/cpu metric on the HPA"
target = cpu["resource"]["target"]
assert target.get("type") == "Utilization" and target.get("averageUtilization") == 70, (
    f"cpu target must be Utilization at 70 percent, got {target}")

print("PASS hpa structural checks")

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout-api
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkout-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: checkout-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/checkout-api:2.1.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8000
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 512Mi
reference_solution.k8s/hpa.yaml:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: checkout-api
  namespace: shop
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: checkout-api
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
